It's a civilian who won't identify himself, says he's going to shake the armed services here until they crack, but it's nothing personal.''"<br />"''It's not my husband again, another of his jokes?''"<br />"''Not&hellip; this time.|Unidentified communications officer and Kadana Sorrel|<ref name="mk" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] ''' individual''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Kadana Sorrel]], a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]].<ref name="mk" />

In [[44 ABY]], his wife was stationed on [[Skifter Station]] in orbit over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. An unidentified civilian sent a transmission to the station claiming they will be shaking the armed forces until they cracked. The [[Unidentified communications officer|communications officer]] forwarded the message to Sorrel and her immediate response was to ask if it was her husband pulling a joke on her.<ref name="mk" />
